text_block_list.text:
I happen to bump into
Матиканэтангейзер while
she's
mid-training and stop to talk with her

when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Awww! Look at that super cute stroller
over there!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
It even has Umamusume ears attached to
it! And
one of them has a pink ribbon.
How sweet!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер
choice_data_list: I wonder if it's a baby Umamusume?

text_block_list.text:
That must be the baby's mom and dad
next to the
stroller.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
But the mom doesn't have Umamusume
ears.
Maybe they're just racing fans.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! As if! Who would be a fan of
someone as
average as m—
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text: Wha... Oh no!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
It all happens in less than a second. The
father's
backpack bumps against the
stroller, and it starts
to roll down the
riverbank quickly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Dash, dash, dash! Whoosh!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew! Just in the nick of time...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text: Oh my goodness!
text_block_list.name: Mother

text_block_list.text: Are you all right?!
text_block_list.name: Father

text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! I'm more worried about your
baby! Wait,
where is she?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Oh... Safe in her mother's arms... I didn't
even
realize...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Man, I can't believe I just dove after an
empty
stroller. That was embarrassing...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but it was all for nothing. The
parents kept
apologizing and thanking
me too.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
I'm really glad the cute stroller was fine,
but...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Jeez... When am I finally gonna get a
break? I just
wanna look really cool for
once...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text: Of course I didn't!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
I thought the baby was going to hurtle
down the
riverbank if I didn't do
something.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text: Sigh. But, well... Hehe. Guess I goofed.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэтангейзер tries to hide her

embarrassment by laughing, but I think
she did a
really noble thing today.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэтангейзер may feel
dissatisfied, but the
parents seem
genuinely grateful.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
